correctness.rationale: The model uses n symbols, n-1 dependent windows, exact normalized Zipf with fixed s>1, and distinct nonloop transitions. For a fixed ordered nonloop pattern, adjacent occurrences are impossible; for its unordered version the adjacent joint probability is p_i p_j(p_i+p_j). The dependency neighborhood has size at most three and the conditional-dependence term is zero; applying the zero-event Poisson bound and splitting off finitely many heavy rows and columns makes the summed error o(n^gamma log n). The divisor count for ij indexed by (nc^2)^gamma gives the coefficient gamma c^(2gamma), and the integral of 1-exp(-a u^-s) is a^gamma Gamma(1-gamma). The factor 1/2 for unordered pairs then gives 2^(gamma-1). In the variance step a fixed disjoint pairing of positions loses at most three windows when t-1,t,t+1 are excluded, leaving at least n/3 independent windows for large n. A change in the count requires one of at most four old/new pairs to be absent in those windows. The resulting weighted divisor estimate yields Var=O(n^gamma log n). Summable Chebyshev bounds on geometric grids and monotone interpolation prove the strong laws; the variance also gives L2. The linear identities transfer both limit modes and the positive denominator limits justify the two different reciprocity fractions. RESULT.md lines 26–99 suffice; the recorded 7,030 tests in VERIFICATION.md are finite checks, not a reproduction of any limit, and the attached script was inspected, not run.

evidence: For the loop count L_n, EL_n <= sum_i min(1,(n-1)p_i^2)=O(n^(gamma/2)). Apply the companion §4 deletion argument to the count restricted to loops: excluding windows touching a symbol changes the count by at most two, and each lost distinct loop can be charged to at most two positions, those in any one of its occurrences. Thus Var(L_n)<=8 EL_n by Efron–Stein. With a_n=n^gamma log n, L_n/a_n tends to zero in L2; Markov on geometric n and monotonicity give the same almost surely.
Subtract L_n from each companion count to obtain D_n,U_n. Now M_n=D_n-U_n, S_n=2U_n-D_n. The two fractions follow by dividing by D_n or U_n, whose leading constants are positive.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The full frozen vector and reciprocity constants are a corollary, even though the companion finding does not spell out those two fractions. No historical order or dependence of discoveries is inferred from catalogue paths.
